mapper.insert: INSERT INTO baseline_workorder (result_id, host_id, rule_id, title, advice, assignee_id, priority, status, close_remark, create_by) VALUES (#{resultId}, #{hostId}, #{ruleId}, #{title}, #{advice}, #{assigneeId}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{closeRemark}, #{createBy})

sql.if: AND (w.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR h.hostname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR h.ipv4 LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT w.id AS id, w.title AS title, w.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostName, h.ipv4 AS ipv4, w.rule_id AS ruleId, r.rule_name AS ruleName, w.assignee_id AS assigneeId, u.user_name AS assigneeName, w.priority AS priority, w.status AS status, w.create_time AS createTime, w.start_time AS startTime, w.finish_time AS finishTime FROM baseline_workorder w LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = w.host_id LEFT JOIN baseline_rule r ON r.id = w.rule_id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = w.assignee_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY FIELD(w.status, 'OPEN', 'PROCESSING', 'DONE'), w.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM baseline_workorder w LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = w.host_id WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT w.id AS id, w.result_id AS resultId, w.host_id AS hostId, h.hostname AS hostName, h.ipv4 AS ipv4, h.mac_address AS macAddress, w.rule_id AS ruleId, r.rule_name AS ruleName, r.rule_code AS ruleCode, r.category AS category, w.title AS title, w.advice AS advice, w.assignee_id AS assigneeId, assignee.user_name AS assigneeName, w.priority AS priority, w.status AS status, w.close_remark AS closeRemark, w.create_by AS createBy, creator.user_name AS creatorName, w.create_time AS createTime, w.start_time AS startTime, w.finish_time AS finishTime, br.check_key AS checkKey, br.expected_value AS expectedValue, br.actual_value AS actualValue, COALESCE(br.evidence, br.message) AS evidence, br.status AS resultStatus FROM baseline_workorder w LEFT JOIN hosts h ON h.id = w.host_id LEFT JOIN baseline_rule r ON r.id = w.rule_id LEFT JOIN baseline_result br ON br.id = w.result_id LEFT JOIN user assignee ON assignee.id = w.assignee_id LEFT JOIN user creator ON creator.id = w.create_by WHERE w.id = #{id}

SELECT id AS id, result_id AS resultId, host_id AS hostId, rule_id AS ruleId, title AS title, advice AS advice, assignee_id AS assigneeId, priority AS priority, status AS status, close_remark AS closeRemark, create_by AS createBy, create_time AS createTime, start_time AS startTime, finish_time AS finishTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM baseline_workorder WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE baseline_workorder SET status = 'PROCESSING', start_time = COALESCE(start_time, NOW()) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN'
UPDATE baseline_workorder SET status = 'DONE', close_remark = #{closeRemark}, finish_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id JOIN user u ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND r.status = 1 AND u.status = 1

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS id, u.user_name AS userName FROM user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.role_code = 'SECURITY_OPERATOR' AND r.status = 1 AND u.status = 1 ORDER BY u.user_name ASC, u.id ASC
